title: PRJ-2 — Projects Customisation And Apple Notes Migration Delivery
summary: add Projects-only folder metadata and controls, migrate the exported Apple Notes corpus into the collection, and report reconciliation gaps
content_html:
PRJ-2 — Projects Customisation And Apple Notes Migration Delivery

Status And Purpose

Closed as PRJ-2 after the local-link contract in PRJ-1. PRJ-2.1 through PRJ-2.3 are complete. The exact approved migration revision 770fe3f1fa466dfb91eaa870bb76bba78d9f79b8506426fffa0093ab720b76f7 created 240 Project documents and 344 media objects, rebuilt and validated the Projects collection, retained its reconciliation report, and restored the previously running Docs watcher.

Detailed file scope, owner tracing, estimates, implementation deviations, and verification evidence are retained in the PRJ-2 Implementation And Verification Record.

This delivery turns dotlineform/projects into a useful folder-notes collection. It adds one Manage-only registered customisation, one optional folder_path metadata field, and a checked-in one-off migration for the exported Apple Notes project corpus. It does not add a generic batch-import or folder-seeding UI.

Complete Outcome

Every Project document can store and edit one normalized Folder Link. The exact value is written to source front matter and projected into that document's namespaced row in local manage-manifest.json. The Projects report can show the link and offer its exact Open in Finder action while the shared default report and public manifest stay unchanged.

A write-free migration plan imports every exported Markdown file as a separate Project document. A reviewed mapping from each exported top-level project folder to a current projects/ folder supplies folder_path where there is an exact or explicitly accepted correspondence. Several documents may share the same path. Notes without a current-folder match remain valid pathless Project documents for later Project State review.

Apply consumes the exact reviewed plan, creates only its preallocated targets, and can resume without allocating new identities or duplicating committed documents. The migration produces a gap and exception report; it does not consolidate notes, create empty documents for uncovered folders, or synchronize the collection with the filesystem.

Observed Migration Inventory

The planning snapshot at $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/Notes export - 2026-05-18/iCloud/dotlineform/projects contains:

  • 240 Markdown files across 201 exported top-level project folders;
  • 206 current direct child folders under projects/;
  • 192 exact top-level folder-name matches, covering 228 Markdown files;
  • 12 Markdown files in 9 unmatched exported folders;
  • 19 exported folders containing more than one Markdown file; and
  • 346 referenced exported assets.

The migration planner must recompute and hash the real inventory rather than treat these counts as immutable. The current exceptional-reference snapshot includes one applenotes: link, nine likely unrecoverable sandbox: links, referenced RTF and TXT files outside the ordinary attachment allowlist, and one already-normalized media token that the package parser must preserve rather than treat as another exported asset.

Example: One Document And One Image

The real exported architecture folder is a simple one-document package. Its input paths are:

input exported path
Markdown $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/Notes export - 2026-05-18/iCloud/dotlineform/projects/architecture/architecture.md
image $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/Notes export - 2026-05-18/iCloud/dotlineform/projects/architecture/images/07542CE2-C708-42A0-B1C1-6B5C489183DA.jpg

The original image reference is:

![07542CE2-C708-42A0-B1C1-6B5C489183DA](images/07542CE2-C708-42A0-B1C1-6B5C489183DA.jpg)

The approved plan allocated d-20260801-212422-1debbe and created these external-local targets:

output external local path
Project source $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/docs-viewer/scopes/dotlineform/source/sub-scopes/projects/documents/d-20260801-212422-1debbe.md
image $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/docs-viewer/scopes/dotlineform/published/media/img/d-20260801-212422-1debbe-image-01.webp

The 600 by 600 JPG remains 600 by 600 and is converted to WebP. The UUID filename is replaced by the owning document identity plus a stable per-document image index. The rewritten source reference is:

![d 20260801 212422 1debbe image 01]([[media:docs/dotlineform/img/d-20260801-212422-1debbe-image-01.webp]] "d 20260801 212422 1debbe image 01")

The resulting source front matter is:

---
doc_id: d-20260801-212422-1debbe
title: architecture
added_date: "2026-08-01 21:24:22"
last_updated: "2026-08-01 21:24:22"
folder_path: projects/architecture
---

The plan and receipt retain the exact original relative path plus source and output hashes. Independent validation confirmed both targets, and rendered acceptance confirmed the WebP at 600 by 600 pixels.

Fixed Design Notes

  • The configured collection selects a known projects customisation; no runtime branch infers behavior from scope, sub-scope, title, or filename.
  • folder_path is optional convenience metadata, not identity, validity, or a lifecycle condition.
  • folder_path belongs only to Project document source and the namespaced Docs Viewer Manage projection. PRJ-2 neither reads nor changes Studio Works and adds no Studio field, UI control, payload, hook, or service dependency.
  • Project-specific row data lives only in the customisation namespace of the local Manage manifest.
  • The ordinary/public manifest remains {doc_id, title} and imports no Manage customisation module.
  • Edit Metadata reads and writes the exact validated Project document.
  • Documents may be created with no path or with an in-root relative path that does not yet exist.
  • The path validity and activation root is $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/; a Project document may deliberately represent a contained folder outside projects/.
  • The migration source is the exact dated Apple Notes export above. It does not scan other Notes exports or treat the general import staging area as migration input.
  • Folder association uses the exported top-level project folder as provenance. Exact names may be proposed automatically; every unmatched folder requires an explicit reviewed mapping or an explicit no-current-folder result. There is no fuzzy matching.
  • Every Markdown file is a separate Project document. All documents beneath one reviewed exported folder may deliberately share the same folder_path.
  • Existing collection documents are not overwritten, consolidated, or adopted by title or body similarity. Any metadata update to an existing document is a separate exact-target action.
  • Supported referenced assets use the existing import media pipeline. Unsupported, missing, applenotes:, and sandbox: references are preserved where safe and reported; PRJ-2 does not infer replacement targets or attempt link recovery.
  • Pathless imported documents and current folders with no Project document are retained as visible reconciliation gaps for the later Project State report.
  • Existing, missing, duplicate, and prospective documents remain untouched unless they are exact confirmed mutation targets.

PRJ-2.1 Contract: Project Metadata, Editor, And Projection

PRJ-2.1 is one exact source-to-projection workflow, not merely an extra field in manage-manifest.json:

Edit Metadata -> Folder Link field
  -> exact Project document metadata save
  -> normalize and validate
  -> write folder_path to source front matter
  -> rebuild Projects
  -> project customisation.folder_path into manage-manifest.json
  -> refresh the Projects report

Source Authority

  • Project document source front matter is authoritative. The stored value is one optional decoded POSIX path relative to $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/, for example folder_path: projects/architecture.
  • manage-manifest.json is a generated read model, not storage or mutation authority. Its exact Project-document row receives only customisation.folder_path after source validation and rebuild.
  • Blank metadata removes folder_path from source. The field may point to a missing or prospective contained folder, and several documents may store the same value.

Registered Projects Customisation

  • The configured dotlineform/projects collection selects one explicit Manage-only Projects customisation ID. The server registry, controlled manifest projector, and Manage browser registry use that same identity.
  • The Projects browser contribution adds report row/detail presentation and a narrow Edit Metadata contribution. The generic report and metadata modal do not infer Projects behavior from scope, sub-scope, title, or path.
  • PRJ-2.1 adds one additive customisation host/contract to Edit Metadata because the current report contribution seam does not own modal fields. It does not add a generic custom-field schema engine or hardcode folder_path into every metadata form.
  • No public customisation loader is registered. Default reports, other sub-scopes, ordinary manifests, and public manifests retain their existing shapes and behavior.

Exact Edit Metadata Flow

  • Opening Edit Metadata for a Project document hydrates the exact canonical source through {scope: "dotlineform", sub_scope: "projects", doc_id} and retains its source-revision receipt. It does not populate the field from the index row or Manage-manifest projection.
  • The read response exposes the source-owned value to the registered contribution as record.customisation.folder_path. The contribution renders one text field labelled Folder Link and displays the decoded relative value, such as projects/architecture.
  • Save retains the same exact target and source revision and submits only the Projects contribution's strict customisation.folder_path value. Unknown customisation fields, missing target data, stale revisions, and use on an unconfigured collection fail closed.
  • The server-owned Projects metadata adapter normalizes and validates the input, updates only the exact document's folder_path front matter, and invokes the existing confined sub-scope rebuild owner. Folder Link changes do not advance last_updated; the existing body/title/summary recency allowlist remains unchanged.
  • A successful response returns the exact committed target and normalized value. If source commit succeeds but report refresh or presentation fails, retry only that follow-through; never repeat the metadata mutation against an inferred or replacement document.

Folder Link Input And Paste

  • The field accepts an already normalized decoded relative value such as projects/architecture.
  • It also accepts an absolute Finder/POSIX path, a local file: URL, or an absolute POSIX path with ordinary shell-display backslash escapes. Save uses the PRJ-1 server normalizer to remove the configured base and store only the decoded relative target.
  • Markdown such as [Architecture](dlf-local:projects/architecture) and raw dlf-local: values are rejected. Those are body-link representations, not structured metadata values.
  • Paste remains the browser's native text-input operation. There is no custom clipboard interception, execCommand, synthetic Undo, or paste status message. Normalization occurs on Save. The current modal closes before its asynchronous server write; an invalid or out-of-root value makes no source change and appears through the existing Manage error presentation.
  • Validation proves a canonical contained target but does not require the target folder to exist.

Manage Projection And Report Controls

  • After the exact source write and rebuild, the local Manage manifest row is:

    {
  "doc_id": "d-example",
  "title": "Architecture",
  "customisation": {
    "folder_path": "projects/architecture"
  }
}

  • A document with no folder_path has no projected folder value. Malformed source values fail controlled projection rather than leaking into the report.

  • The Projects report contribution reads only its validated namespaced row data. It shows the exact path, an explicit no-link state, and duplicate use of one path without changing collection membership or repairing it.

  • PRJ-2.1 does not scan the filesystem or project a derived existence flag. A stored path may be current, missing, or prospective; Project State owns that classification later. Open in Finder may report a missing target when the user explicitly invokes it.

  • Open in Finder submits the exact projected relative target through the PRJ-1 local activation owner. It never falls back to the selected parent, displayed document, title, URL text, or another document's path.

Delivery Discipline

PRJ-2 should remain one registered sub-scope customisation plus one checked-in migration command under docs-viewer/migrations/. The command reuses existing Apple Notes normalization, media, import planning/apply, atomic document creation, and confined rebuild owners. It must not write source through a parallel document writer or introduce another manifest format, generic registry, folder synchronization service, batch-import endpoint, or general bulk-workflow framework.

PRJ-2.0 must record the exact proposed files, reused owners, durable migration plan/receipt shape, and rough production/test diff size. If the implementation materially exceeds the one-field projector, exact-target controls, and one-source migration described here, pause for review and move the extra capability into a separately accepted delivery. Line count is a scope signal, not a reason to compress or duplicate code.

Rough Delivery Steps

PRJ-2.0 — Freeze Customisation And Migration Contracts

  • [x] Trace current dotlineform/projects config, default report host, manifests, metadata schema/modal, document creation, and sub-scope customisation registries.
  • [x] Freeze folder_path source validation, Manage-manifest row shape, browser descriptor, row/detail controls, and public exclusion.
  • [x] Trace the ordinary Markdown/Apple Notes normalization, media rewrite, import plan/apply, document creation, rebuild, and existing migration seams.
  • [x] Freeze export inventory ownership, one-file/one-document title rules, stable identity allocation, source and asset hashes, reviewed top-level folder mapping, pathless output, exception reporting, and result locations.
  • [x] Freeze exact-plan apply, resumable receipt, collision refusal, supported asset handling, and committed rebuild retry behavior.
  • [x] Record the exact file list, reused seams, rough production/test diff estimate, and any proposed expansion before implementation approval.

Checkpoint: one reviewed contract covers a manually created prospective document, a linked existing document, several imported documents sharing one path, an unmatched pathless import, an exceptional reference, and an existing collection document that the migration leaves untouched.

PRJ-2.1 — Project Metadata, Editor, And Projection

  • [x] Implement the Project Metadata, Editor, And Projection contract above.
  • [x] Register the Manage-only Projects server/projector and browser customisation pair, plus its narrow additive Edit Metadata contribution; do not register a public loader or add a generic custom-field engine.
  • [x] Hydrate record.customisation.folder_path from the exact canonical Project source and render the Projects-only Folder Link field.
  • [x] Preserve native paste, normalize relative/absolute/file: path input on Save through the PRJ-1 server owner, and reject Markdown or dlf-local: representations.
  • [x] Write or remove folder_path only through the exact target and source revision, then use the existing confined Projects rebuild owner.
  • [x] Project only validated customisation.folder_path row data into local manage-manifest.json; leave default and public manifests unchanged.
  • [x] Render the exact path, no-link state, duplicate use, and exact Open in Finder without adding filesystem classification or changing membership.
  • [x] Verify exact hydration/save, stale revision, blank removal, relative and pasted absolute input, invalid/out-of-root input, missing target, duplicate path, absent customisation, and public/default exclusion.

Checkpoint: manually accepted. The Nerve Folder Link saves and projects; Open in Finder and Open in VS Code work; and the Projects list and manage-manifest.json update from the exact source.

PRJ-2.2 — Apple Notes Migration Plan And Apply

  • [x] Add a checked-in one-off migration command with explicit plan, apply, and validate modes and the exact dotlineform/projects destination.
  • [x] Plan every Markdown file and referenced asset without collection writes, allocate stable document identities, hash the inputs, and emit a sanitized review report plus machine-readable plan.
  • [x] Propose exact folder-name mappings, require explicit decisions for all unmatched folders, allow multiple documents to share one path, and retain explicit no-current-folder results without inventing a match.
  • [x] Reuse the existing Apple Notes normalization and supported-media rewrite per Markdown file even when its export folder contains other Markdown files.
  • [x] Report preserved unsupported, missing, applenotes:, and sandbox: references without recovery guesses or silent loss.
  • [x] Apply only the exact reviewed create-only plan. Revalidation rejects changed inputs and unexpected target or media collisions.
  • [x] Persist enough exact receipt state to recognize already committed plan targets on retry, fail on mismatched content, and never allocate replacement identities or create duplicates.
  • [x] Rebuild the collection once after the planned source writes. A post-commit rebuild failure retries the rebuild only.

Checkpoint: the checked-in command and temporary external-local fixture are complete. Review this slice before PRJ-2.3. The real dated export remains untouched, local migration artifacts do not exist, and docs-watcher has not been stopped; PRJ-2.3 owns the write-free real plan and the later accepted watcher-quiesced apply.

PRJ-2.3 — Apply Real Migration And Review Gaps

  • [x] Run focused config, projector, metadata, customisation registry, migration-plan, exact-target, resume, exception-report, public-boundary, lint, and whitespace checks.
  • [x] Plan the real dated export before any apply and review representative odd names, explicit unmatched-folder decisions, multi-note folders, source/media collisions, and exceptional references.
  • [x] After explicit acceptance, quiesce the Docs live rebuild watcher through its owning local service, record that no watcher or Docs build remains active, and only then apply the exact plan. Keep it quiesced across any resumable partial failure so it cannot publish an intermediate collection.
  • [x] After the migration-owned rebuild and validation succeed, restore the previously running watcher/service, verify it is healthy, and inspect the real default/list/detail behavior at realistic density.
  • [x] Produce the reconciliation report: current folders with zero, one, or several associated documents; pathless imports; unmatched export folders; untouched existing documents; and unresolved asset/link exceptions.
  • [x] Transfer the shipped extension contract to the durable sub-scope customisation architecture and retain Projects-specific product meaning in the Projects Concept.

Completion checkpoint: revision 770fe3f1fa466dfb91eaa870bb76bba78d9f79b8506426fffa0093ab720b76f7 created and validated 240 documents and 344 media objects. Together with the untouched baseline Nerve document, the collection now contains 241 documents: 229 with Folder Links and 12 pathless. The retained result groups 206 current folders into 14 with zero documents, 176 with one, and 16 with several. The plan-bound receipt records all documents complete and rebuild: complete.

Not In Scope

  • continuous folder/document synchronization;
  • a generic batch-import UI, API, or reusable bulk-workflow framework;
  • ordinary Import browsing outside staging, tracked separately in Docs Import Folder Source Selection;
  • automatic empty-document creation for current folders without an imported note;
  • automatic note consolidation or existing-document deduplication;
  • recovery or inferred replacement of applenotes: and sandbox: links;
  • automatic rename, merge, delete, or stale-link repair;
  • Work or Series reconciliation;
  • Project State report generation;
  • Resolver Tokens; or
  • public folder metadata.

Completion Evidence

  • Exact apply and independent --validate passed for revision 770fe3f1fa466dfb91eaa870bb76bba78d9f79b8506426fffa0093ab720b76f7.
  • The rebuilt public and Manage manifests each contain 241 unique document IDs. Manage projects 229 non-empty Folder Links and 12 pathless rows; the public rows remain {doc_id, title} only.
  • The migration published 328 WebP images and 16 byte-preserved attachments; the result report retains all 12 exceptional occurrences without repair.
  • The owning bin/local-studio watcher was suspended with no Docs build active, then resumed healthy after apply and validation.
  • Rendered acceptance covered the 241-row report, duplicate and pathless states, linked and pathless metadata, the disabled pathless Finder action, and converted architecture media with no browser console errors.
  • Manual and imported Project documents share the same front-matter and manifest contract.
  • Default and public sub-scope payloads remain byte-compatible and folder-blind.
  • The customisation uses exact document targets and handles missing/duplicate paths as visible states.
  • The migration plan is write-free, identifies every source and target, and records explicit pathless and exceptional-reference results.
  • Apply is create-only for the exact reviewed plan; retry recognizes committed targets and cannot allocate replacements or duplicate documents.
  • The final report distinguishes zero, one, many, and no-current-folder states without repairing them ahead of Project State.
  • Real collection review distinguishes generated projection evidence from manual UI acceptance.
